messages:
alice: FYI we just got verbal ok from NorthStar for a shared pilot. they want Redwood + Partner infra in a co-sell model. need a concise runbook for governance, SSO, data handling, and a pricing blurb for their procurement team. can anyone own the technical runbook?
marina: Congrats! I can draft the runbook. do we have a target timeline from the partner?
sahil: partner asked to start next Monday (tight). pilot = 4 weeks, SSO + sample prod data, throughput 50 req/s, 90k tokens/day estimate.
natalie: Partner engineering here — we'll provide a sandbox VPC and NAT. need details on required ports, keys, and supported model variants (quantized vs fp16).
alice: thanks. procurement wants an "example cost" line item they can put in the SOW. can we give a sensible conservative estimate? include both Hosted + Dedicated paths.
ryan: security questions incoming. they will send an external questionnaire (third-party risk). we should prepare answers for data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, and SOC/ISO stack. i'll take point on security answers.
marina: outline i'll use for runbook: 1) scope & goals 2) infra diagram 3) onboarding steps 4) SSO & access 5) data flows & retention 6) failover/fallback plan 7) cost estimate and how to scale.
sahil: for the infra diagram: Redwood hosted with partner VPC peering vs Private (on-prem) — recommend starting Hosted + partner VPC for speed. can we list recommended instance types for 50 req/s?
natalie: yes. rough guidance: 2x A10G equivalent for low-latency serving with autoscale to 4 during peak. for Dedicated we propose g4dn.xlarge equivalent for baseline and a GPU pool reserved if they want steady throughput.
alice: perfect. marina — can you include a quick table: Hosted path (tokens pricing), Dedicated estimate (monthly GPU commit), and an option for "private (on-prem)" with ballpark infra + professional services? procurement wants something they can drop into the SOW.
marina: will do. sample wording for procurement: "Redwood will provide hosted inference for pilot. Estimated monthly pilot cost: $6k–$9k (hosted, incl. storage & bandwidth). Dedicated pilot option: $12k–$18k/month (reserved GPUs + support). On-prem estimate: $TBD (depends on customer infra)." want me to tighten numbers?
alice: good start. tighten to a single-line table for SOW. i'll flag that numbers are estimates subject to actual token volume.
natalie: question re keys: partner wants to manage keys on their side for request signing. does Redwood support partner-managed signing keys + mTLS?
marina: yes — we support mTLS and external signing for VPC peering. add the snippet below to runbook for example route config:

```
# Example route config
remote_peer: northstar-vpc
auth: mTLS
allowed_ports: [443]
kms: partner-managed
```

marina: (cont) i'll add a small diagram and list of required firewall rules.
ryan: security Qs to prep: data classification, retention policy (default 30 days, can be shortened), encryption (AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit), personnel access (RBAC + audit logs). also ask them for their compliance requirements (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA).
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "New shared-pilot workspace created: pilot-northstar-2026 — invite sent to alice, marina, natalie." :package: 
marina: i'll post an initial draft runbook by EOD today. can @sahil confirm the exact throughput numbers and provide a sanitized sample payload for perf testing?
sahil: sending sample payload now via DM. throughput confirmed. also, partner asked about SLA during pilot — we should propose a 99.5% uptime for pilot, measured at request-level.
alice: ok proposal: 99.5% pilot SLA, escalation to partner eng for incidents, and automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant if capacity constrained. add that to runbook.
marina: noted. final checklist for immediate owners: 1) runbook draft — marina 2) procurement cost blurb — marina & alice 3) security questionnaire template — ryan 4) infra diagram + ports — natalie 5) perf payload + test plan — sahil. i'll tag each section in the doc.
alice: thanks team. i'll sync with partner's lead (ct@northstar) at 3pm. please have your sections ready by 2pm for quick review.
sahil: will be ready.
ryan: prepping the security answers now. will pull SOC2 artifacts.
natalie: prepping VPC details and a terraform snippet for peering (will paste into runbook).
marina: draft uploaded: https://redwood-internal/s/shared-pilot-runbooks/pilot-northstar-1865 (please review). i'll iterate quickly after feedback. :rocket:
